output.summary: The win-rate drop is mainly a mix and process artifact. From 2026-04-15 the MQL threshold fell to 40 and opportunities began auto-creating, with a 60-day auto-close. The 40-59 band is 750 closed opportunities and a 3.3% win rate. Excluding it, Q3 win rate is 29.4% against 31.0% in Q1. Non-marketing win rate is flat. Rep activity is up, comp and attrition are stable, and the price cut shows no effect. Lead vendor quality at equal score is unresolved (Q1). The CEO's accountability program would punish reps for a measurement and funnel change. Prefer re-baselined reporting and rerouting 40-59 leads with a one-quarter review. Defer vendor termination until the matched comparison is done.
